title: Signed agent-skill registries land as enterprise procurement default by Q4 2026
body: By Q4 2026 the May 7 dual-registry landing — Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 shipping a sandboxed-skill registry that signs and version-pins shareable agent skills with per-tenant Mythos Preview gating tied to AISI cyber-eval results (Project Glasswing extension), and OpenAI graduating the May-1 Codex CLI /goal feature into a /agent command with explicit Plan-Apply two-phase execution alongside ChatGPT Enterprise's per-org agent registry GA with FedRAMP-Moderate authorization + SOC-2 Type II scope expansion to cover the agent registry + audit ledger — combined with the May 7 CISA KEV-catalog addition of n8n CVE-2026-21858 (Ni8mare), the same-day LangChain LangGraph CVE-2026-44012 SSRF (CVSS 9.1) + LiteLLM CVE-2026-44188 auth-bypass (CVSS 8.8) disclosure pair, the +34%/4-week MCP-server exposure compounding (~9,400 internet-exposed servers, ~58% with no authorization controls), and the May 7 Microsoft Defender for Cloud MCP-server threat-detection module GA forces enterprise procurement RFPs to name a signed-skill registry + per-tenant capability gating + per-org audit-ledger triple as a baseline requirement for any agentic-AI orchestrator entering the enterprise tier. The forcing function is that the dual-registry shape now spans both major frontier labs and is reinforced by hyperscaler-side telemetry (Defender XDR for MCP) within the same disclosure window — enterprise CISOs and procurement teams adopt the registry-first posture as the operational answer to the n8n KEV catalog + LangGraph/LiteLLM CVE pair. The shape is most likely an explicit RFP control family naming sandboxed-skill registry + per-tenant Mythos-class capability gating + per-org audit ledger, not a generic "AI governance" line item. Hyperscaler-managed registry tiers (Microsoft Foundry / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex) ship parallel offerings within the same window to avoid being the lone hold-out without a contractual control plane.

reasoning.because: Anthropic + OpenAI both shipped signed agent-skill / per-org agent registries on May 7.
reasoning.given: n8n Ni8mare KEV add + LangGraph SSRF + LiteLLM auth-bypass force agentic-platform governance.
reasoning.so_that: Enterprise procurement RFPs name signed-skill registry + per-tenant gating as baseline for agentic orchestrators.
reasoning.landing: By Q4 2026; >=1 hyperscaler-managed registry tier ships in parallel.
reasoning.plain_language: Anthropic and OpenAI both launched signed agent registries the same day; soon enterprise buyers will require them in contracts.

summary: Anthropic Claude Code 3.0 ships a sandboxed-skill registry + per-tenant Mythos gating same day OpenAI launches a per-org agent registry with FedRAMP-Moderate authorization. By Q4 2026 enterprise RFPs name signed-skill registry + per-tenant capability gating as baseline for agentic-AI orchestrators.
